question: Who among the following wrote the book ‘Redesign the World: A Global Call to Action’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sam Pitroda.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sam Pitroda wrote the book ‘Redesign the World: A Global Call to Action’.**
 
• Dr. Sam Pitodra is better known as "The father of India's communication revolution".
 
• He is a policymaker, investor, and entrepreneur.
 
• Presently, he is the chairman of India's National Knowledge Commission (NKC), besides being the Chairman and CEO of World-Tel and the founder and CEO of C-SAM, Inc.
 
• In 1992, he was also an advisor to the United Nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's 71-Year Test: The Journey to Triumph in Australia is written by **R.Kaushik.**
 
• Inglorious Empire, Why I am a Hindu, Pax Indica, Bookless in Baghdad written by** Shashi Tharoor.**
 
• **Books by Arundhati Roy **are The Algebra of Infinite Justice, The God of Small Things, and The Ministry of Utmost Happiness.
